summary: Alvotech filed a Form 6-K on October 5, 2026, furnishing a press release announcing FDA approval of a BLA supplement allowing AVT02 (adalimumab-ryvk, marketed as SIMLANDI) drug substance for U.S. commercial supply to be manufactured in a second Reykjavik suite, DSM2, effectively doubling U.S.-supporting capacity. The approval follows the FDA's July 2026 VAI classification closing the latest Reykjavik inspection. No securities, ownership, pricing, or deal terms are involved — this is a routine regulatory/manufacturing milestone, not a special situation. Watch pending BLAs (AVT05, AVT06, AVT03, AVT16/AVT80) for further approvals.
